title: IRIS² CONSTELLATION: MDA SPACE TO PROVIDE THALES ALENIA SPACE WITH DIGITAL ANTENNA SUBSYSTEMS FOR 66 EARLY-DELIVERY SATELLITES
summary: TORONTO, ON (OCTOBER 30, 2026) – MDA Space Ltd. (TSX:MDA) (NYSE:MDA), a trusted mission partner to the global defence and space industry, has entered into
body_markdown:
**TORONTO, ON (OCTOBER 30, 2026)** – MDA Space Ltd. (TSX:MDA) (NYSE:MDA), a trusted mission partner to the global defence and space industry, has entered into an agreement with Thales Alenia Space, a joint venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), to begin work on MDA AURORA™ broadband digital phased array antennas and digital antenna controller for the 66 “Layer 1” IRIS² satellites in low Earth orbit. IRIS² (Infrastructure for Resilience, Interconnectivity and Security by Satellite), the EU Secure Connectivity Programme, will be the new standard bearer for Europe’s autonomous and sovereign space capability. The authorization to proceed (ATP) agreement is valued at more than $100M.


With their digital beamforming capabilities and performance, the MDA AURORA™ direct radiating arrays (DRA) will serve as key enablers within this strategic program.


“Entering into this ATP to deliver critical digital antenna subsystems for the first set of Layer 1 IRIS² satellites, to be launched in 2029, is a landmark moment for MDA Space and our AURORA™ technology,” said Mike Greenley, CEO of MDA Space. “This critical role reflects the confidence Thales Alenia Space and the European Commission have placed in our ability to offer quickly performing, interoperable connectivity that meets the requirements of the Layer 1 satellites.”


MDA Space draws on decades of proven expertise in high‑performance satellite payloads and experience delivering critical SATCOM technology to the private sector and governments around the world, and this mandate adds to the MDA Space national sovereign programs of record. The MDA AURORA™ system and associated subsystems are engineered for high‑volume production and are designed, manufactured and tested in MDA Space’s state-of-the-art facility in Montréal.


The IRIS² ATP contract will be included in MDA Space’s backlog in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026. The definitive contract for MDA Space’s full scope of work is subject to contract finalization.
